# Checks, radios and switches

The browser's own checkbox and radio, drawn by the library: `check`, `radio` and `switch` on the input itself, `form-check` on the label around it.

## Examples

The class goes on the `<input>`; the label wraps it, so a click anywhere on the words toggles it.

```html
<fieldset class="vstack gap-8">
	<legend class="form-label">Included</legend>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" checked>Transfer</label>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" checked>Lunch</label>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox">Kayaks</label>
</fieldset>
```

### Radios

Radios with one `name` are one choice; the arrow keys move it.

```html
<fieldset class="vstack gap-8">
	<legend class="form-label">Departure</legend>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="radio" type="radio" name="check-radios-time" checked>Morning, 8:30</label>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="radio" type="radio" name="check-radios-time">Noon, 12:00</label>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="radio" type="radio" name="check-radios-time">Sunset, 16:30</label>
</fieldset>
```

### Switches

A switch is a checkbox with `role="switch"`: on or off, applied at once. One that cannot change keeps its focus with `aria-disabled="true"` and says why in a hint.

```html
<label class="form-check"><input class="switch" type="checkbox" role="switch" checked>Show on the site</label>
<div class="vstack gap-4">
	<label class="form-check"><input class="switch" type="checkbox" role="switch" aria-disabled="true" aria-describedby="check-switches-why">Hide “Powered by REDZ CMS”</label>
	<div class="form-text" id="check-switches-why"><i class="bi bi-lock" aria-hidden="true"></i> Available with a partner license</div>
</div>
```

## States

A check with some of its items chosen is `indeterminate` — a property set from script, as there is no attribute for it.

## Keyboard and accessibility

- Space toggles a check or a switch; the arrow keys move the choice among radios of one `name`.
- A set of checks or radios sits in a `<fieldset>` whose `<legend>` names it.
- The marks are drawn from the browser's own `:checked` and `:indeterminate`, and keep showing in forced colors and in print.
- `aria-disabled="true"` keeps the control focusable and readable, so its hint can say why; the library ignores clicks and Space on it, as on a button so marked.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/check.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/check.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-border-strong`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-primary-contrast`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-focus`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-motion`, `--redz-ease`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `form-check-inline` | — | review | hstack gap-16 around the labels |
| `form-check-input` | — | review | check, radio or switch on the input, by its type |
| `form-check-label` | — | remove | the label is the form-check around the input |
| `form-check-reverse` | — | missing |  |
| `form-switch` | — | review | switch on the input, with role="switch" |
